subject: expression: provide `OptPropPrivilegeChecker` for `EvalContext` (#56302)
summary: Diff vs first parent moves privilege checks out of `exprctx.EvalContext` into a new optional eval property `OptPropPrivilegeChecker` (`expropt.PrivilegeChecker` + provider/reader). Privilege-sensitive builtins (e.g. `tidb_mvcc_info`, `tidb_decode_sql_digests`, sequence funcs, extension funcs) and planner codec helpers are updated to fetch a checker via optional props and use it for `RequestVerification`/`RequestDynamicVerification`. `sessionexpr.NewEvalContext` now always supplies the privilege-checker provider. No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, privilege/visibility, or concurrency regressions found within the touched expression/planner code; no later upstream/master follow-up specifically adjusting the new privilege-checker property was found.
